blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video diffusion models generate visually compelling short-term sequences but often struggle to preserve scene geometry and object structure over time. In this paper, we first demonstrate that current video attention cannot identify reliable correspondences across frames, with responses dispersed across multiple regions even after recognizable scene structure has emerged. We argue that reliable cross-frame associations are essential for information exchange as scene structure forms in video generation. Thus, we introduce Geometry Attention Distillation (GAD), which transfers correspondences from a frozen geometry model's attention to video attention. Extracted from clean videos, these correspondences link the same static surface or moving object across frames. Since structure formation begins in deeper layers at higher noise and shallower layers at lower noise, we apply attention distillation at a student layer selected according to the noise timestep. After training, video attention focuses more consistently on corresponding locations. Experiments across all three video backbones demonstrate improved long-range scene consistency and dynamic temporal consistency, with geometric gains across generation lengths. On Wan2.2 5B, GAD improves cross-frame matching accuracy by at least 30% over the Wan baseline on both long-range benchmarks. Notably, GAD achieves these gains without additional inference modules, offering a promising approach to efficient and consistent video-based world simulation. Project page: https://fantasy-amap.github.io/GAD/.
blocks.zh: 视频传播模型产生视觉吸引人的短期序列,但往往在一段时间内为保存场景几何和物体结构而挣扎. 在本文中,我们首先表明,目前的视频注意力无法辨别出跨帧的可靠对应信息,即使在出现可识别的场景结构后,反应也分散在多个区域. 我们主张,可靠的跨框架协会作为场景结构形式在视频生成中对于信息交流至关重要。 因此,我们引入了几何注意力分解(GAD),它将函文从被冻结的几何模型的注意力转移到了视频注意力上. 从干净的视频中取出,这些通信将相同的静地表面或移动对象连接到相框上. 由于结构形成开始于更深的地层,而更浅的地层开始于更低的地层,因此我们在根据噪音时序选择的学生地层进行注意力分馏. 培训后,视频注意力更一致地集中在相应的地点. 跨越所有三个视频主干线的实验显示,长距离场景一致性和动态时间一致性得到了提高,几何增益跨代长度. 在Wan2.2 5B上,GAD在两个远程基准上将跨帧匹配精度比Wan基线提高至少30%. 值得注意的是,GAD在没有额外推论模块的情况下取得了这些成果,为高效和一致的以视频为基础的世界模拟提供了一个很有希望的方法。 项目网页:https://fantasy-amap.github.io/GAD/.

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent video diffusion models [ 5 , 33 , 71 , 57 ] generate visually compelling sequences from text and images, yet struggle to preserve scene geometry over time and maintain coherent object structure during motion. Such consistency is essential for interactive world modeling [ 68 , 49 ] , robotic planning [ 17 , 32 ] , and autonomous driving simulation [ 21 , 64 ] , where generated videos must represent temporally coherent environments.
blocks.zh: 近期的视频传播模型[5,33,71,57]从文字和图像中产生视觉引人入胜的序列,然而在运动期间却努力保存场景几何并保持连贯的物体结构. 这种一致性对于互动世界建模[68,49],机器人规划[17,32],以及自主驾驶模拟[21,64]至关重要,其中生成的视频必须代表时间上一致的环境.

blocks.en:
To improve consistency, existing approaches employ camera-aware positional encoding [ 36 , 72 ] , explicit geometric conditioning [ 53 , 6 , 25 ] , history-conditioned generation [ 37 , 78 ] , and geometry-aware feature alignment [ 65 , 23 ] .
However, such guidance does not ensure that video models reliably associate observations of the same scene element across frames, a capability essential for consistent video generation.
blocks.zh:
为提高一致性,现有方法采用相机感知位置编码[36,72],显式几何调值[53,6,25],历史条件生成[37,78],几何感知特征对齐[65,23].
然而,这种指导并不能确保视频模型可靠地将同一场景要素的观测与跨帧连接起来,而这种能力对于视频生成的一致性至关重要。

blocks.en:
To understand how cross-frame associations develop, we examine attention patterns in video models and the emergence of scene structure across noise levels and network depths.
Our analysis shows that video attention cannot reliably identify the same scene element across frames: its responses are often dispersed across multiple regions, even after recognizable scene structure has emerged.
Such ambiguous associations can mix information from unrelated regions, undermining the preservation of scene geometry and object structure across frames.
Ideally, cross-frame attention should connect observations of the same scene element, enabling information exchange that supports consistent structure formation. We further observe that recognizable scene structure begins to emerge in deeper layers at higher noise and shallower layers at lower noise. This suggests guiding video attention where structure and cross-frame associations are beginning to form, with the guidance depth adapted to the noise level. For a source of this guidance, we turn to geometry foundation models [ 35 , 58 ] with promising multi-view matching capabilities.
Probing VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 59 ] reveals attention responses that associate the same static surface or moving object across frames, providing geometric correspondence targets for guiding video attention.
blocks.zh:
为了了解跨框架关联是如何发展的,我们考察了视频模型中的关注模式以及场景结构在噪声水平和网络深度的出现.
我们的分析表明,视频注意力无法可靠地确定同一场景元素跨帧:其反应往往分散在多个区域,即使在可识别的场景结构出现之后.
这种模棱两可的联系可以混合来自无关区域的信息,破坏场景几何和跨帧物体结构的保存.
理想的情况是,跨框架注意力应连接同一场景要素的观测,从而能够进行有助于结构形成的一致性的信息交流。 我们进一步观察到,可识别的场景结构开始在更深的层层中出现,在更高的噪音中出现,在更低的噪音中出现更浅的层. 这表明,在结构和跨框架协会开始形成的地方,指导人们注意录像,指导深度适应噪音水平。 作为这一指导的来源,我们转向几何基础模型[35,58],具有有希望的多视图匹配能力.
探索VGGT - 堆积 \ OMGA [59] 揭示了将相同的静态表面或移动对象连在一起的注意力响应,为引导视频注意力提供几何对应目标.

blocks.en: Building on these insights, we introduce Geometry Attention Distillation ( GAD ), an attention distillation framework that guides cross-frame associations during structure formation. During training, we extract correspondence targets from the attention of a frozen geometry model on clean videos. The total attention each source token assigns to a target frame serves as a reliability cue for weighting its supervision. We select the student layer for attention distillation according to the noise timestep, guiding cross-frame associations as scene structure forms. At the selected layer, pairwise supervision encourages spatial discrimination within frame pairs, while trackwise supervision extends temporal coverage by matching a common source to multiple target frames. These complementary distillation objectives are optimized jointly with the original video generation loss, transferring cross-frame relations while preserving the flexibility of video representations. After training, video attention focuses more consistently on corresponding regions across frames, while generated videos better preserve scene geometry and moving-object structure.
blocks.zh: 基于这些见解,我们引入了几何注意力分解(GAD),这是一个注意力分解框架,在结构形成过程中指导跨框架关联. 在训练期间,我们从一个冷冻的几何模型的注意力中提取通信目标在干净的视频上. 每个源代码对目标框架的总关注度是对其监督进行加权的可靠性提示。 我们根据噪音时间步骤来选择学生的注意力蒸馏层,引导跨帧协会作为场景结构形式. 在选定的层中,双向监理会鼓励帧对内的空间差异,而跟踪监理则通过将一个共同的源与多个目标帧匹配来延长时间覆盖范围. 这些互补的蒸馏目标与最初的视频生成损失一起进行优化,转移跨帧关系,同时保持视频表达的灵活性. 经过培训后,视频注意力更加一致地集中在相应的跨帧区域,而生成的视频则更好地保存场景几何和移动-对象结构.

blocks.en:
We evaluate GAD on camera-controlled video generation using RealEstate10K and DL3DV-10K for long-range scene consistency and OmniWorld-Game for dynamic consistency.
Across all three video backbones, GAD improves geometric consistency in long-range generation and temporal consistency in dynamic generation.
Geometric improvements across generation lengths further support the applicability of GAD across backbone configurations and video durations.
Notably, with Wan2.2 5B, GAD delivers at least a 30% relative improvement in cross-frame matching accuracy on both long-range benchmarks, without additional inference modules or computations.
blocks.zh:
我们用RealEstate10K和DL3DV-10K对相机控制的视频生成进行GAD评价,用于远距离场景一致性,OmniWorld-Game则用于动态一致性.
在所有三个视频主干网中,GAD提高了长程生成中的几何一致性和动态生成中的时间一致性.
跨代长度的几何改进进一步支持了GAD在主干配置和视频持续时间上的应用.
值得注意的是,由于Wan2.2 5B,GAD在两个远程基准上的跨框架匹配精度至少相对提高30%,没有额外的推论模块或计算。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We analyze cross-frame associations in video models, revealing persistent geometric ambiguities in attention and a noise-dependent shift in the depth at which scene structure begins to form. These observations motivate geometry attention distillation at layers where structure is emerging. • We propose GAD , an attention distillation framework that transfers geometric correspondence knowledge to video attention for improved cross-frame consistency. • Extensive experiments demonstrate that GAD improves long-range scene consistency and dynamic temporal consistency across all three video backbones, with consistent improvements across generation lengths and no additional inference modules.

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1  Consistent Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 连续视频生成

blocks.en:
Video diffusion models [ 20 , 5 , 33 , 71 , 57 ] generate visually compelling videos but still struggle to maintain consistent scene geometry and object structure across frames. Existing efforts [ 69 , 26 , 84 ] address these limitations through temporal coordination, historical context, and spatial guidance. Sampling strategies improve temporal continuity [ 51 , 44 , 67 , 9 ] while attention design regulates information exchange [ 83 , 55 ] . Long-range generation further benefits from compressed or hierarchical context [ 78 , 85 , 80 , 7 ] , selective memory access [ 66 , 30 , 14 , 70 ] , and training that addresses error accumulation and long-context dependencies [ 73 , 8 , 12 ] . Camera-aware positional encodings complement this temporal context with spatial guidance [ 36 , 72 , 29 ] .
These approaches improve information retention and exchange across frames, but do not necessarily ensure that attention connects observations of the same scene element. Complementing these efforts, GAD uses geometric correspondences to directly supervise video attention, guiding associations between observations of the same scene element across viewpoints and through motion.
blocks.zh:
视频传播模型 [20, 5, 33, 71, 57] 生成视觉上具有说服力的视频,但仍在挣扎着保持一致的场景几何和横跨帧的物体结构. 现有努力[69、26、84]通过时间协调、历史背景和空间指导来解决这些局限性。 抽样战略提高了时间连续性[51、44、67、9],而注意力设计则规范信息交流[83、55]。 远程生成还得益于压缩或分级上下文[78,85,80,7],选择性内存访问[66,30,14,70],以及解决错误积累和长关联依赖性的培训[73,8,12]. 相机-知位编码以空间导[36,72,29]补充这一时间背景.
这些方法改进了信息保留和跨框架的交流,但不一定能确保注意将同一场景要素的观测联系起来。 作为这些努力的补充,GAD使用几何通信来直接监督视频的注意,指导同一场景要素的观测之间通过各种观点和运动进行关联.

blocks.en: 2.2  Geometry Foundation Models for Video Consistency
blocks.zh: 2.2 视频一致性几何基础模型

blocks.en:
Geometry foundation models [ 61 , 60 , 58 ] make learned structural priors accessible to video generation. Together with explicit representations, these priors provide spatial references for view-conditioned synthesis [ 37 , 74 , 76 , 42 ] and persistent scene memory [ 25 , 63 , 45 ] . Geometry also guides learning through feature alignment and positional encoding [ 65 , 31 ] , joint appearance–geometry modeling [ 43 , 13 , 10 ] , and depth or motion constraints [ 3 , 18 ] . Preference optimization and reinforcement learning further use geometric feedback to improve generated content [ 16 , 2 , 62 , 1 ] . However, methods using explicit geometric conditions [ 53 , 6 ] can inherit reconstruction and reprojection errors and face additional challenges in dynamic scenes.
While implicit geometric learning [ 23 , 22 ] offers greater flexibility for dynamic scenes, direct feature alignment may still impose representational constraints beyond those needed for geometric consistency.
To this end, GAD draws correspondence targets from geometry model attention to supervise cross-frame associations in video attention, transferring relations between observations of the same scene element without matching feature representations or requiring reconstructed geometry at inference.
blocks.zh:
几何基础模型 [61, 60, 58] 使学习到的结构前科可以进入视频生成. 这些前情提要连同明确的表述,为视差条件合成[37、74、76、42]和持续场景记忆[25、63、45]提供了空间参考。 几何学也通过特征对齐和位置编码[65,31],联合外观-几何模型[43,13,10],深度或运动约束[3,18]来指导学习. 优惠优化与强化学习进一步利用几何反馈来改进生成的内容[16,2,62,1]. 然而,使用明确几何条件的方法[53,6]可以继承重建与再预测错误,并在动态场景中面临更多挑战.
虽然隐含的几何学习[23,22]为动态场景提供了更大的灵活性,但直接的特征调整仍然可能会施加超出几何一致性所需的代表性限制.
为此,GAD从几何模型的注意点中引来对应目标,在视频注意点中监督跨帧关联,转移相同场景元素的观测之间没有匹配的特征表示点或需要在推断时重建几何关系.

blocks.en: 2.3  Attention Distillation and Correspondence Supervision
blocks.zh: 2.3 注意力稀释和通信监督

blocks.en:
Knowledge distillation can transfer attention patterns and relational structure in addition to individual features [ 77 , 56 , 52 ] , with cross-stage connections shaping how teacher knowledge reaches the student [ 11 ] . In diffusion models, feature alignment [ 75 , 28 , 4 ] and token-relation distillation [ 79 , 38 ] provide complementary supervision, refined through token selection or noise-dependent prior granularity [ 48 , 46 ] .
Diffusion representations also support correspondence estimation [ 54 ] , consistent video editing [ 19 , 50 ] , and sampling guidance [ 86 ] .
More directly, CAMEO [ 34 ] improves novel-view synthesis by supervising a fixed attention layer with correspondences derived from static 3D pointmaps.
For consistent video generation, GAD instead extracts reliability-weighted correspondences from geometry model attention across static surfaces and moving object parts, and routes attention distillation to student layers according to the noise timestep to guide cross-frame associations during structure formation.
blocks.zh:
知识衍射除了个别特征外,还可以传递注意力模式和关系结构[77,56,52],跨阶段连接塑造教师知识如何到达学生[11]. 在扩散模型中,特征对齐[75、28、4]和符号关系蒸馏[79、38]提供补充性监督,通过符号选择或依赖噪声的前颗粒性加以改进[48、46]。
传播表述也支持函证估计[54],一致的视频编辑[19,50],以及抽样指导[86].
更直接地说,CAMEO [34]通过监督一个固定的注意层与来自静态3D点映射的函射来改进小说-视图合成.
对于一致的视频生成,GAD转而从静态表面和移动物体部分的几何模型注意中提取可靠性加权的函文,并根据噪音时序将注意力分馏到学生层,以指导结构形成过程中的跨帧关联.

blocks.en: 3  Analysis and Motivation
blocks.zh: 3 分析和动机

blocks.en: 3.1  Attention Patterns in Video Models
blocks.zh: 3.1 视频模型中的注意模式

blocks.en:
Cross-frame consistency requires associating the same scene element across viewpoint changes or object motion. We examine how video attention establishes these associations across noise levels and network depths.
In Fig. 2(a) , we fix a source query and a target frame within a single video generation trajectory, and visualize the target frame’s intermediate token features using PCA alongside query-to-target attention responses. The PCA visualizations reveal recognizable scene structure, while the attention maps show whether responses concentrate near the reference correspondence or favor other regions. Further visualization details are provided in Section E.1 .
blocks.zh:
跨帧一致性要求将同一场景元素连接在视角变化或物体运动中. 我们研究视频关注如何在噪音水平和网络深度之间建立这些关联。
在图2(a)中,我们在单一的视频生成轨迹中固定一个源查询和一个目标帧,并使用PA与查询对目标注意的答复一起,可视化目标帧的中间符号特征。 PCA可视化显示可识别的场景结构,而注意图则显示反应是集中在参考函证附近还是偏向其他区域. E.1节提供了进一步的可视化细节。

blocks.en:
This joint analysis reveals two key findings. First, video attention cannot reliably identify the same scene element across frames. Its responses can remain dispersed across multiple regions, including those with similar appearance or semantics, even after recognizable scene structure has emerged in the PCA features. Second, the emergence of scene structure and cross-frame associations depends on both noise level and network depth. We distinguish three qualitative regimes.
In the noise-dominated region , PCA features show little recognizable scene structure, while attention responses remain scattered rather than concentrated around the corresponding region.
In the structure-formation region (red boxes in Fig. 2(a) ), recognizable scene structure begins to emerge, and attention starts to respond to corresponding regions across frames, although competing responses remain. This region occurs in deeper layers at higher noise and shallower layers at lower noise.
In the structure-established region , scene layout is more clearly defined in the PCA features and cross-frame associations are more apparent, but they are not necessarily geometrically accurate.
blocks.zh:
这一联合分析揭示了两项关键结论。 首先,视频注意力无法可靠地识别出同一场景元素跨帧. 其反应仍可分散在多个区域,包括外观或语义相似的区域,即使在五氯苯甲醚特征出现可识别的场景结构之后。 其次,场景结构和跨帧关联的出现既取决于噪音水平,也取决于网络深度. 我们区分了三种定性制度。
在以噪音为主的区域中,五氯苯甲醚的特征很少显示出可识别的场景结构,而注意力反应仍然分散,而不是集中在相应的区域。
在结构-构型区域(图2(a)中的红框),可辨认的场景结构开始出现,注意力开始对横跨框架的相应区域作出反应,尽管仍然存在相互竞争的反应. 这个区域在更深的层中发生,在更高噪音时发生,在较低噪音时发生更浅的层.
在已建立的结构区域中,场景布局在PCA特征中得到了更明确的界定,跨帧关联也更明显,但不一定几何准确.

blocks.en:
These observations motivate explicitly guiding video attention toward geometrically corresponding regions to help preserve scene and object structure across frames.
Furthermore, the three observed regimes suggest that the placement of this guidance matters. In the noise-dominated region, weak structural evidence may make correspondence supervision difficult to exploit; in the structure-established region, additional guidance may have less opportunity to shape associations that have already formed.
The structure-formation region offers an intermediate stage where correspondence learning has a structural basis while the associations are still developing. We therefore hypothesize that geometric guidance is most effective in this region. Since this region emerges at different depths depending on noise, we adapt the supervision layer to the noise timestep.
blocks.zh:
这些观测活动明确引导视频关注到几何对应的区域,以帮助保存场景和跨帧的物体结构.
此外,所观察的三个制度都表明,这一指导的设置很重要。 在以噪声为主的区域,薄弱的结构证据可能使函证监督难以利用;在结构既定的区域,额外的指导可能较少有机会形成已经形成的协会.
结构形成区域提供了一个中间阶段,即函授学习具有结构基础,而社团仍在发展之中。 因此,我们假设几何指导在该区域最为有效。 由于这个区域因噪声的不同而在不同深度出现,因此我们使监督层适应噪声的时序.

blocks.en: 3.2  Geometric Correspondence in Geometry Foundation Models
blocks.zh: 3.2 几何基础模型中的几何函授

blocks.en:
Recent advances in geometry foundation models have demonstrated strong multi-view matching capabilities, motivating their use as a source of correspondence supervision. Probing VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 59 ] , we find that attention from selected layers and heads captures correspondences on both static surfaces and moving objects. As shown in Fig. 2(b) , attention responses remain concentrated around the same railing location across viewpoint changes in the static example, and follow the person’s hat as the person moves in the dynamic example. These observations suggest that geometry model attention can guide associations with the same scene element across both camera and object motion.
Visualization details and layer–head selection are described in Sections E.2 and B.1 .

blocks.en: 5.2  Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 结果

blocks.en:
Compared with the Wan baselines, GAD improves cross-view matching and camera accuracy while achieving better FID, FVD, and CLIP scores across both datasets and all three backbones Table 1 . Notably, on Wan2.2 5B, matching hit rate increases by at least 30% on each dataset. These gains demonstrate improved geometric consistency alongside better generation quality.
With Wan2.1 14B, GAD achieves the best results across all seven metrics on both datasets, indicating that its benefits extend to a larger backbone.
Qualitative comparisons in Figs. 4 and 7 further show that GAD better preserves scene layout and geometric structure throughout long-range camera-controlled sequences.

与Wan基线相比,GAD提高了跨视比和相机精度,同时实现了更好的FID,FVD,和CLIP在数据集和所有三个主干线上的分数. 值得注意的是,在Wan2.2 5B上,每个数据集的匹配命中率至少增加30%。 这些成绩表明,在提高发电质量的同时,几何一致性也有所提高。
有了Wan2.1 14B,GAD在两个数据集的所有七个度量数据上都取得了最佳结果,表明其效益延伸到更大的主干.
在Figs中进行定性比较. 4和7进一步显示,GAD更好地保留了整个远程相机控制序列的场景布局和几何结构.

blocks.en:
Across all three backbones, GAD improves subject consistency, background consistency, and motion smoothness over the corresponding Wan baseline ( Table 2 ). With Wan2.1 14B, it achieves the best scores on these metrics among the evaluated methods. Improvements in both subject and background scores suggest that correspondence supervision is useful beyond static scene content, consistent with transferring relations between moving objects rather than enforcing fixed spatial locations. Lower FID and FVD and higher CLIP scores further indicate that these gains coexist with improved generation quality and text alignment. Qualitative comparisons in Figs. 4 and 8 complement these scores: GAD better preserves the structure of moving characters and foreground objects, while maintaining a more stable background layout as the viewpoint changes.
Attention visualizations in Fig. 5 further show that, compared with the Wan baseline, GAD focuses video attention more consistently on corresponding scene regions in both static and dynamic examples. These more localized responses accompany better preservation of scene geometry and moving-object structure in the generated videos.
blocks.zh:
在所有三个支柱中,GAD都比相应的Wan基线(表2)改善了主题的一致性、背景一致性和运动平滑性。 有了Wan2.1 14B,它在这些评测方法上取得了最好的分数. 主题和背景分数的改进表明,通信监督在静态场景内容之外是有用的,与转移移动物体之间的关系一致,而不是强制固定空间位置. 较低的FID和FVD以及较高的CLIP分数进一步表明,这些增益与更好的生成质量和文本对齐并存. 在Figs中进行定性比较. 4和8补充了这些分数:GAD更好地保留了移动字符和前景对象的结构,同时随着视角的变化保持了更稳定的背景布局.
图5的注目可视化进一步显示,与万年基线相比,GAD在静态和动态例子中更一致地将视频注意力集中在相应的场景区域. 这些更本地化的反应与在生成的视频中更好地保存场景几何和移动对象结构同时进行.

blocks.en:
On DL3DV-10K with Wan2.2 5B, we further evaluate generation at 5, 10, and 15 seconds, separately training GAD and its Wan baseline under matched settings for each duration. As shown in Table 4 , GAD improves all four geometric metrics at every duration, and complete results in Table 7 show broadly comparable or improved generation quality. Together, these results demonstrate the applicability of our method across backbone configurations and generation lengths.
Notably, GAD achieves these gains without additional inference modules or computations, preserving the backbone’s inference procedure. Table 2 reports unchanged peak GPU memory and minor runtime differences consistent with run-to-run variability. Time-weighted average memory is also sensitive to variations in the duration of individual execution stages.
blocks.zh:
在DL3DV-10K和Wan2.2 5B上,我们进一步评估生成时间为5、10和15秒,在匹配的设置下分别培训GAD及其Wan基线。 如表4所示,性别与发展指数在每个期间都改进了所有四个几何度量度,表7的完整结果显示了大致可比或改进的生成质量。 这些结果共同表明,我们的方法适用于骨干配置和生成时间。
值得注意的是,GAD在没有额外推论模块或计算的情况下实现这些收益,维护了骨干推论程序. 表2报告GPU内存未变峰值,运行时间差异小,与运行间变异一致. 时间加权的平均内存对单个执行阶段的期间变化也很敏感.

blocks.zh: 表5:蒸馏部分膨胀。 信心教师权重(CAT)与轨迹监督(TWS)和双轨监督(PWS)相结合,在所有七个衡量标准中都取得了最佳效果。

blocks.en: 5.3  Ablations
blocks.zh: 5.3 违约

blocks.en: Using Wan2.2 5B on DL3DV-10K, we ablate the noise-timestep routing schedule, confidence-aware teacher weighting, and pairwise and trackwise supervision to assess their contributions.
blocks.zh: 使用DL3DV-10K上的Wan2.2 5B,我们降低噪音时步路程表,提高师资信心的权重,并双向和跟踪监督来评估他们的贡献.

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 4 , fixed-layer supervision (R2–R4) already improves geometric metrics over the Wan baseline (R1), while the proposed noise-timestep routing (R8) outperforms all other configurations (R1–R7); complete metrics appear in Table 6 . Thus, correspondence targets are useful on their own, while their placement determines how effectively they guide generation. The lower performance of R5–R7 compared with R2–R4 further suggests that varying supervision with noise is insufficient without an appropriate layer choice.
These results support the motivation in Section 3 : supervision should adapt to the noise timestep to target the structure-formation region rather than constrain a fixed layer throughout denoising.
blocks.zh:
如表4所示,固定层监理(R2-R4)已经比Wan基线(R1)改进了几何计量标准,而拟议的噪音-时序路由(R8)则超过所有其他配置(R1-R7);完整的计量标准见表6。 因此,函授目标本身是有用的,而其定位决定了它们如何有效地指导生成. 与R2-R4相比,R5–R7的性能较低,这进一步说明,没有适当的层层选择,噪声下的不同监督是不够的。
这些结果支持第3节的动机:监督应适应噪声时间步,以瞄准结构形成区域,而不是在整个消音过程中限制固定层。

blocks.en: Table 5 shows that transferring teacher correspondences indiscriminately is insufficient: without confidence weighting, matching hit rate falls below the Wan baseline despite modest improvements in camera error. This supports accounting for uncertainty in teacher matches rather than treating every target equally. With confidence weighting, either pairwise or trackwise supervision improves all geometric metrics, while their combination performs best across all seven metrics. The joint gains are consistent with their complementary roles: pairwise supervision discriminates spatial matches within a target frame, whereas trackwise supervision extends correspondence coverage across time.
blocks.zh: 表5显示,不分青红皂白地转让教师函文是不够的:没有信心加权,相匹配的命中率低于万世基线,尽管相机误差略有改善。 这有助于说明教师匹配中的不确定性,而不是平等对待每个目标。 通过置信度加权,双向或跟踪监督可以改进所有几何度量衡,而其组合在所有7个度量衡中表现最好。 联合收益与其互补作用是一致的:对等监管在目标框架内区别对待空间匹配,而对轨监管则将函证涵盖的时间延伸。

blocks.en: 6  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We have presented GAD , an attention distillation framework that transfers geometric correspondence knowledge from a frozen geometry teacher to video attention.
Motivated by geometric ambiguities in video attention and the noise-dependent emergence of scene structure, GAD guides cross-frame associations during structure formation while preserving the video model’s representational flexibility.
Experiments show that GAD consistently focuses attention on corresponding regions and improves long-range scene consistency and dynamic temporal consistency across all three video backbones, with geometric improvements across generation lengths. These gains require no additional inference modules. Our findings highlight geometric correspondence transfer through attention as a promising approach to consistent video generation and video-based world simulation.
blocks.zh:
将几何学知识从冷冻的几何老师转移到视频注意力。
由于视频注意力中的几何模糊和场景结构的出现取决于噪声,GAD在结构形成过程中引导跨帧关联,同时保留了视频模型的代表灵活性.
实验显示,GAD始终关注相应的区域,提高所有三个视频主干线的长距离场景一致性和动态时间一致性,跨代长度的几何改进. 这些成果不需要额外的推论模块。 我们的调查结果突出表明,通过注意进行几何通信传输,是持续制作视频和以视频为基础的世界模拟的有希望的方法。

blocks.en: B.1  Teacher Targets and Alignment
blocks.zh: B.1 教师目标和调整

blocks.en: We select the teacher layer–head pair using reference correspondences from both static and dynamic scenes. For the static set, we randomly sample 50 DL3DV scenes and estimate per-view depth and camera parameters with VGGT- Ω \Omega , retaining only high-confidence depth estimates. Inspired by CAMEO [ 34 ] , we construct correspondence labels through cycle projection. A sampled source pixel is unprojected into 3D using its depth and camera parameters, then projected into a target view and assigned to a target token. We unproject the center of that target token using the target-view depth and project it back into the source view. A correspondence is retained only if the projections remain in bounds, the projected and estimated depths agree in both directions, and the return location is sufficiently close to the source sample. When multiple samples within a source token pass these checks, we retain the correspondence with the smallest cycle error. These are geometry-derived reference labels, rather than manually annotated ground truth. For the dynamic set, we use the provided ground-truth point correspondences from 30 dynamic scenes in TAPVid-DAVIS [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们从静态和动态场景中选择教师层头对。 对于静态集,我们随机抽取50个DL3DV场景,并用VGGT-complete \Omega 来估计每个视图的深度和相机参数,只保留高强度的深度估计. 在CAMEO[34]的启发下,我们通过周期投影构建对应标签. 采样的源像素使用它的深度和相机参数未被预测为3D,然后投射到目标视图,并分配到目标符号上. 我们利用目标视野的深度解析目标标志的中心,并将其投射回源视图. 只有在预测仍然有限度、预测深度和估计深度在两个方向上一致、返回地点与来源样本足够接近的情况下,才能保留函证。 当一个源代码中的多个样本通过这些检查时,我们保留与最小周期错误的对应. 这些是几何学衍生的参考标签,而不是手动注释的地面真理. 对于动态集,我们使用TAPVid-DAVIS[15]中30个动态场景提供的地面-真实点对应.

blocks.en: We randomly sample query tokens from the input frame of each video and examine every global-attention layer–head pair. For each query, we extract the maximum-response location in each subsequent view and its target-frame attention mass, following Eq. 1 . We compare the predicted locations with the reference correspondences to measure correspondence error and examine the associated attention masses as reliability cues. Considering correspondence consistency across both static and dynamic tokens, we select layer 13, head 10, which provides the best overall performance in this evaluation. All layer and head indices here are zero-based, and this single pair is used for training-label extraction in all experiments.
blocks.zh: 我们从每个视频的输入框中随机抽取查询符,并检查每个全局关注层-头对。 对于每个查询,我们提取每个后续视图中的最大响应位置及其目标框关注质量,跟随Eq. 1. 我们比较预测地点和参考函证,以衡量函证错误,并作为可靠性提示来审查相关的关注量。 考虑到静态和动态符号之间的对应一致性,我们选择第13层,标题10,这为本次评价提供了最佳的总体业绩。 这里的所有层和头指数都是零基的,这对单对在所有实验中都用于训练-标签提取.

blocks.en: The evaluation also reveals substantial specialization across heads. For example, layer 13, head 0 captures static-token correspondences well but fails to reliably associate dynamic tokens, whereas layer 12, head 12 captures dynamic-token correspondences well but performs poorly on static tokens. Other pairs exhibit little correspondence consistency for either type of token. These observations motivate selecting a pair using both static and dynamic scenes, rather than relying on either set alone.
blocks.zh: 评价还显示,各主管具有高度专业化。 例如,第13层,头部0能很好地捕捉静态音符,但未能可靠地连接动态音符,而第12层,头部则能很好地捕捉动态音符,但在静态音符上表现不佳. 其他的对子在两种标志上几乎没有任何对应的一致性。 这些观测结果促使人们利用静态和动态场景来选择一对,而不是只依靠两个场景。

blocks.en: The depth-and-camera cycle projection above assumes a static scene and therefore cannot directly recover correspondences for moving scene elements. We also observe substantial errors around thin structures and closely spaced surfaces, where depth errors and token discretization can associate different surfaces. These limitations can affect methods that rely on such projection-derived supervision, including CAMEO. Extracting correspondences from VGGT- Ω \Omega attention instead exploits the model’s learned cross-view consistency without imposing a static-scene projection constraint. In our observations, this alleviates these failure cases and also supports correspondences for dynamic scene elements.
blocks.zh: 上面的深度和相机循环投影假设一个静态场景,因此无法直接恢复移动场景元素的通信. 我们还观察到围绕薄薄结构和紧密间距的表面存在大量错误,在这些地方,深度误差和象征性的圆盘化可以将不同的表面联系起来. 这些限制可能影响依赖这种预测产生的监督的方法,包括CAMEO。 从 VGGT- complete\ Omega 注意来校正对应, 而不是在不施加静态场景投影限制的情况下, 利用模型所学到的交叉视图一致性 。 在我们的观察中,这可以缓解这些故障案例,也支持动态场景元素的通信.

blocks.en: Appendix C Experimental Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录C 议定书

blocks.en: C.1  Data Preparation and Conditioning
blocks.zh: C.1 数据准备和条件

blocks.en: We use RealEstate10K and DL3DV-10K for 15-second long-range generation and OmniWorld-Game for 5-second dynamic generation. DL3DV-10K uses its official evaluation set; RealEstate10K and OmniWorld-Game use scene-disjoint training and test splits. All methods receive the first image, the text prompt, and the target camera trajectory for the same clip.
blocks.zh: 我们使用RealEstate10K和DL3DV-10K进行15秒长距离生成,OmniWorld-Game进行5秒动态生成. DL3DV-10K使用其官方评价集;RealEstate10K和OmniWorld-Game使用场景-脱节培训和测试拆分. 所有方法都收到第一个图像,文本提示,以及同一片段的目标相机轨迹.

blocks.en: RealEstate10K cameras are obtained from COLMAP reconstructions and aligned to the video frame indices. Their translation scale is aligned to a Depth Anything 3 [ 39 ] metric reference. DL3DV-10K uses VIPE camera estimates aligned to the extracted RGB frames. For OmniWorld-Game, we use the game subset from the xhigh tier of the SolarWM [ 24 ] release, together with its camera annotations and captions. Spatial preprocessing applies the same crop and resize to RGB images and camera intrinsics. Camera trajectories are expressed relative to their first frame, and model-specific translation scaling is applied separately from the common evaluation trajectory.
blocks.zh: RealEstate10K摄像头从COLMAP重建中获取,并与视频帧指数对齐. 它们的翻译比例表与深度 Anything 3 [39] 度量参考一致。 DL3DV-10K使用与提取的RGB帧一致的VIPE相机估计. 对于OmniWorld-Game,我们使用SolarWM [24]发行的x高阶游戏子集,连同其相机说明和字幕. 空间预处理将同样的裁剪应用到RGB图像和相机的内在内容上并调整大小. 相机轨距相对于其第一帧表示,模型特定翻译缩放与共同评价轨迹分开应用.

blocks.en: C.2  Baseline Adaptation
blocks.zh: C.2 基线适应

blocks.en: The Wan baselines follow Appendix B . For GF, Gen3R, Voyager, Gen3C, and Uni3C, we use their released implementations and checkpoints with adapters for the shared image, prompt, and camera inputs. Each method retains its native generation procedure, including any depth estimation, geometry rendering, and history conditioning. Outputs are aligned to the common evaluation resolution of 832 × 480 832\times 480 and to 241 or 81 timestamps at 16 fps. Native frame counts and model resolutions can differ; the adapters transform camera intrinsics with the corresponding image geometry.
blocks.zh: Wan的基线遵循附录B。 对于GF、Gen3R、Voyager、Gen3C和Uni3C, 我们使用它们释放的安装和检查点与适配器进行共享图像、即时和相机输入。 每种方法都保留其原生生成程序,包括任何深度估计、几何渲染和历史条件。 产出与832×480 832\times 480的共同评价分辨率和16 fps时的241或81倍标值一致. 原生帧计数和模型分辨率可以不同;适配器将相机的内在变化与相应的图像几何.

blocks.en: GF retains its sparse-keyframe prediction and iterative interpolation procedure over the requested trajectory. Gen3R generates three 49-frame segments, conditioning each subsequent segment on the previous generated endpoint. Removing duplicate endpoints yields 145 native frames, which are aligned to the 241 evaluation timestamps by nearest-timestamp resampling. Voyager and Uni3C generate three 81-frame segments with one shared endpoint, yielding 81 + 80 + 80 = 241 81+80+80=241 frames. Voyager propagates the previous generated RGB-D endpoint while retaining its initial world cache; its four internal prefix frames are removed from each segment’s decoded output. Uni3C uses the previous generated endpoint as the next reference image and constructs its geometric conditions for the next segment. Gen3C uses its native long-video generation path over the requested camera sequence. Its adapter preserves the input field of view by resizing and padding to the native canvas, then removes the padding and resizes the output for evaluation. Segment continuation uses generated content rather than additional ground-truth RGB frames.
blocks.zh: 通用金融工具在所要求的轨迹上保留其稀缺的关键框架预测和迭代插值程序。 Gen3R生成三个49帧的片段,在之前生成的端点上对后续的片段进行调节. 删除重复的端点可产生145个本地帧,这些帧通过最近的时标重印与241个评价时间戳一致. Voyager和Uni3C生成三个81帧片段,有一个共享端点,生成81+80+80=241 81+80+80=241帧. Voyager在保留其初始世界缓存的同时,传播了先前生成的RGB-D端点;其四个内部前缀框从每个段的解码输出中移除. Uni3C使用之前生成的端点作为下一个参考图像,并为下一个段构建其几何条件. Gen3C使用其本土的长视频生成路径来覆盖所请求的相机序列. 其适配器通过调整本地画布的大小和加载来保存视图的输入字段,然后去掉加载,调整输出的大小以供评价. 片段继续使用生成的内容而不是额外的地面真实RGB框架.

blocks.en: The OmniWorld-Game adapters cover the same 0–5-second interval. Voyager and Uni3C use one 81-frame segment, with Voyager retaining its internal prefix mechanism. GF retains its keyframe and interpolation procedure. Gen3R generates 49 native frames and resamples them to 81 output timestamps. Gen3C generates a 121-frame native window over the same interval and selects the nearest native timestamps for the 81-frame evaluation sequence. These conversions change the temporal sampling of the output, not the evaluated camera interval.
blocks.zh: OmniWorld-Game适配器覆盖相同0-5秒间隔. Voyager和Uni3C使用一个81帧段,Voyager保留其内部前缀机制. GF保留其关键框架和内插程序. Gen3R 生成49个本土帧,并将其复制到81个输出时间戳. Gen3C在同一间隔内生成121帧本地窗口,并为81帧评价序列选择最近的本地时间戳. 这些转换改变了输出的时间采样,而不是被评价的相机间隔.

blocks.en: Warping-based methods are sensitive to camera scale because their explicit scene initialization and geometric conditioning depend on depth estimated from the first frame. Camera translations must therefore be expressed at a scale consistent with this depth; a mismatch produces an inconsistent initial scene and incorrect warps, which can propagate errors into subsequent predictions. This dependence on depth–camera scale calibration is a practical limitation of these explicit geometric methods. To provide suitable geometric inputs for a fair comparison, we carefully align camera translations with the depth scale used by each baseline, using the dataset- and model-specific corrections described below. For Gen3C and Voyager, the DL3DV adapter applies the recorded VIPE-to-MoGe scale, approximately 0.370913 0.370913 . On RealEstate10K, their input translations use the per-scene COLMAP-to-DA3 scale followed by the fixed DA3-to-MoGe factor, approximately 0.632710 0.632710 . GF and Gen3R retain their internal camera normalization after the common input conversion. For Uni3C on RealEstate10K, camera translations are aligned to the DA3 depth scale using a per-scene scale factor.
blocks.zh: 基于Warping的方法对相机尺度很敏感,因为其明显的场景初始化和几何条件取决于从第一帧估计的深度. 因此,相机翻译的表达范围必须与这一深度一致;不匹配会产生不一致的初始场景和不正确的曲面,这可以将错误传播到之后的预测中. 这种对深度-相机尺度校准的依赖是这些显式几何方法的实际限制. 为了提供进行公平比较的适当几何输入,我们利用下文所述的数据集和模型特定更正,仔细地将相机翻译与每个基线使用的深度尺度保持一致。 对于Gen3C和Voyager,DL3DV适配器应用录制的VIPE对MoGe比例尺,约为0.3709130.370913. 在RealEstate10K上,他们的输入翻译使用每场COLMAP-对DA3比例,然后是固定的DA3-对MoGe系数,大约0.632710 0.632710. GF和Gen3R在共同输入转换后保留了它们的内部相机正常化. 对于RealEstate10K上的Uni3C,相机翻译则使用每个场景尺度系数与DA3深度尺度对齐.

blocks.en: For OmniWorld-Game, the supplied metric poses are scaled by approximately 0.227987 0.227987 for Gen3C/Voyager and 0.597926 0.597926 for Uni3C. These factors were estimated from training-side depth comparisons and fixed before evaluation. GF and Gen3R receive the metric poses without an additional dataset-specific multiplier. Scale factors affect translations only; rotations and intrinsics are unchanged. Common evaluation poses are stored separately and do not include model-specific scale factors.
blocks.zh: 就OmniWorld-Game而言,Gen3C/Voyager的计量面额缩放约为0.2279870.227987,Uni3C为0.5979260.597926。 这些因素是根据培训方面的深度比较估算的,在评价前确定。 GF和GEN3R在没有额外数据集专用乘数的情况下接收度量表. 尺度因素只影响翻译;旋转和内在不变. 常见的评价姿势是单独存储的,不包括模型特有的尺度因素.

blocks.en: C.3  Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: C.3 评价计量

blocks.en: We exclude the first conditioning frame from the target-frame quality measurements. FID uses 2048-dimensional Inception features from frames 4 , 8 , … , T − 1 4,8,\ldots,T-1 , pooled across the complete evaluation set. FVD uses 400-dimensional I3D features from the target-frame video clips and is also computed at the complete-set level. CLIP uses ViT-B/32 image and text embeddings, sampling every fourth target frame and averaging max ( 100 cos ( 𝐞 image , 𝐞 text ) , 0 ) \max(100\cos(\mathbf{e}_{\mathrm{image}},\mathbf{e}_{\mathrm{text}}),0) .
blocks.zh: 我们把第一个条件框架排除在目标框架质量测量之外。 FID使用从帧4,8,......,T−1,4,8,\ldots,T-1的2048维受体特征,集合到整个评价集. FVD使用目标帧视频剪辑中的400维的I3D特性,并且也是按照完整的设定水平计算. CLIP 使用 VIT- B/32 图像和文本嵌入, 每四个目标框架取样并平均最大值( 100 cos (e 映像, e 文本), 0)\max( 100\cos (\ mathbf{ e}_{\ mathrm{image}},\mathbf{ e}_{\ mathrm{text}}), 0) 。

blocks.en: Depth Anything 3 [ 39 ] estimates camera poses from the generated video. Predicted and reference trajectories are each transformed relative to their first camera, and their translations are independently normalized by the maximum distance from that camera. We average the rotation geodesic distance and normalized translation L2 distance over frames. Rotation distances are reported in degrees, as in Table 1 ; translation distances are dimensionless. This normalization evaluates relative trajectory agreement rather than absolute metric scale.
blocks.zh: 深度 Anything 3 [39] 估计摄像头的姿势来自生成的视频. 预测的和参考的轨迹分别相对于他们的第一台相机进行变形,其翻译通过与该相机的最大距离而独立正常化. 我们平均旋转的大地测量距离 和正常的翻译L2距离 如表1所示,旋转距离按度表示;翻译距离为无维度。 这种正常化评估的是相对的轨迹协议,而不是绝对的尺度。

blocks.en: LoMa-B [ 47 ] extracts up to 2,048 keypoints per frame. We compare first-frame-to-target-frame matches in generated and reference videos at frames 4 , 8 , … , T − 1 4,8,\ldots,T-1 . Reference matches are associated with generated matches by their source positions, using a 20-pixel threshold and consuming an assigned generated match only once. A hit additionally requires the target positions to differ by less than 20 pixels. M rate M_{\text{rate}} is the number of hits divided by the number of reference matches; M dist M_{\text{dist}} averages target-position distances over source-assigned matches, including those that miss the target threshold. Dataset-level scores aggregate the corresponding counts and distance sums, rather than averaging scene-level ratios.
blocks.zh: LoMa-B [47] 每帧提取最多2,048个键点. 我们比较第一帧和参考录象带中的第一帧和第一帧的匹配情况。 引用匹配与其源位置生成的匹配相关,使用20像素阈值,只消耗一次指定生成的匹配. 击中还额外要求目标位置的不同小于20像素. M 速率 MQQText{rate} 是点击次数除以参考匹配次数; M dist MQQText{dist} 平均目标位置距离大于源指定匹配,包括那些错过目标阈值的匹配. 数据集级分数汇总了相应的计数和距离总和,而不是平均场景级比.

blocks.en: We use VBench’s custom-input evaluation for the five dimensions in Table 2 : subject consistency, background consistency, motion smoothness, aesthetic quality, and imaging quality. Generated and ground-truth videos are evaluated separately with the same implementation, and each dimension is averaged over videos.
blocks.zh: 我们用V Bench的自定义输入评价来评价表2的五个方面:主题的一致性、背景的一致性、运动的光滑性、美学质量和成像质量。 制作的视频和地面实况视频分别以相同的执行方式进行评估,每个维度均以视频为平均值.

blocks.en: C.4  Inference Cost
blocks.zh: C.4 推论费用

blocks.en: The costs in Table 2 are measured on one NVIDIA A800 using three common OmniWorld-Game scenes, with methods run sequentially. The Wan variants generate 81 frames at 832 × 480 832\times 480 using 50 sampling steps, guidance scale 5, and seed 0. Each external method retains its native resolution, temporal sampling, precision, and offloading policy. The comparison therefore measures the cost of completing the common generation task under each method’s evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 表2中的费用是用一个NVIDIA A800来测量的,使用三个共同的OmniWorld-Game场景,方法按顺序运行. Wan变种在832×480 832\时生成81帧480,使用50个采样步骤,制导比例尺5和种子0. 每一种外部方法都保留其本地分辨率、时间取样、精确度和卸载政策。 因此,比较衡量了根据每种方法的评价规程完成共同生成任务的费用。

blocks.en: Runtime includes required preprocessing, generation, output postprocessing, and generated-video encoding, but excludes model loading and uninstrumented process overhead. GPU memory is monitored with NVML over the scene’s process tree, with a target sampling interval of 50 ms and decimal GB units. Average memory is the time-weighted process-tree memory over the full scene-command duration, including loading and export; peak memory is the maximum sampled value in that run. The table reports the arithmetic mean of each quantity over the three scenes, so its peak-memory column is the mean of the per-scene peaks. For GAD , the trained DiT replaces the corresponding backbone DiT, and no teacher or aggregation MLP is loaded.
blocks.zh: 运行时间包括所需的预处理,生成,输出后处理,以及生成视频编码,但不包括模型加载和未安装的流程管理费. GPU内存通过NVML在场景过程树上进行监控,目标采样间隔为50ms和小数GB单位. 平均内存是整个场景命令期间的时间加权过程-树内存,包括加载和导出;峰值内存是该运行中的最大抽样值. 该表报告在三个场景上每个量的算术平均值,因此其峰-模柱是每场峰的平均值. 对于GAD,经过训练的DiT取代了相应的骨干DiT,没有老师或聚合的MLP被加载.

blocks.en: The Loss Assignment column in Table 6 specifies where the pairwise and trackwise auxiliary losses are applied during training. The eight configurations are: • R1 (Off @ all t t ): The Wan baseline, with no auxiliary attention supervision at any noise timestep. • R2 (L5 @ all t t ): Both auxiliary losses are applied at layer 5 throughout the noise range, testing a fixed shallow supervision layer. • R3 (L15 @ all t t ): Both auxiliary losses are applied at layer 15 throughout the noise range, testing a fixed intermediate supervision layer. • R4 (L25 @ all t t ): Both auxiliary losses are applied at layer 25 throughout the noise range, testing a fixed deep supervision layer. • R5 (L5 @ t ≥ 900 t\geq 900 ): Auxiliary supervision is applied only at layer 5 for high-noise samples with t ≥ 900 t\geq 900 ; samples with t < 900 t<900 receive only the flow-matching loss. • R6 (L25 @ t < 900 t<900 ): Auxiliary supervision is applied only at layer 25 for lower-noise samples with t < 900 t<900 ; samples with t ≥ 900 t\geq 900 receive only the flow-matching loss. • R7 (L25 / L5 @ 900): Auxiliary supervision is routed to layer 25 for t < 900 t<900 and layer 5 for t ≥ 900 t\geq 900 . This schedule assigns a deeper layer to lower noise and a shallower layer to higher noise. • R8 (L5 / L15 / L25 @ 850, 950): Our schedule routes auxiliary supervision to layer 5 for t < 850 t<850 , layer 15 for 850 ≤ t < 950 850\leq t<950 , and layer 25 for t ≥ 950 t\geq 950 , assigning progressively deeper layers as noise increases. For every supervised sample, both auxiliary objectives use the same selected layer; the listed layers are not supervised simultaneously. At each routing boundary, equality belongs to the higher-noise interval. The auxiliary loss weights follow Section B.3 .

blocks.en: For each inspected layer and denoising step, we collect the target frame’s block-output features and project the spatial tokens onto three principal components. PCA is fitted independently for each layer–step pair, with a fixed random seed and deterministic component signs. Each projected channel is scaled using its first and 99th percentiles for RGB display. Because each projection is fitted independently, we compare the spatial organization of regions within each visualization rather than matching colors across cells. As discussed in Section 3.1 , these maps reveal where recognizable scene structure emerges across noise levels and network depth: little coherent structure is visible in the noise-dominated region, scene regions begin to take shape in the structure-formation region, and the scene layout becomes more clearly defined in the structure-established region. The onset of recognizable structure occurs in deeper layers at higher noise and in shallower layers at lower noise. Viewed alongside the attention maps, the PCA features help distinguish the emergence of scene structure from the development of cross-frame associations, showing that attention can still favor competing regions even when the scene layout is recognizable. This joint analysis motivates placing correspondence supervision near the structure-formation stage and adapting the supervised layer to the noise timestep.
blocks.zh: 对于每个被检查的层层和点名步骤,我们收集目标框架的阻塞输出特征,并将空间标志投射到三个主要部分。 五氯苯甲醚为每层-步配对独立安装,有固定的随机种子和确定性成分标志。 每个投影通道都使用它的第一百分位和第九十九百分位来缩放用于RGB显示. 由于每个投影都是独立搭配的,我们比较了每个可视化内部的区域的空间组织,而不是匹配细胞间的颜色. 正如第3.1节所讨论的那样,这些地图揭示了可识别的场景结构在噪声水平和网络深度之间出现的地方:在噪声占主导地位的区域很少能看到连贯的结构,场景区域开始在结构形成区域成形,在结构建立的区域,场景布局变得更加清晰. 可识别结构的开始发生在噪音较高的更深层中,在噪音较低的更浅层中。 与关注图一起看,PCPA的特征有助于区分场景结构的出现和跨框架协会的发展,表明即使场景布局被识别出来,关注仍然可以偏向竞争的区域. 这种联合分析促使将通信监督置于结构形成阶段附近,并使受监督的层适应噪音的时序。

blocks.en: At the same layer and step, we extract queries and keys after normalization and rotary positional encoding. For the fixed source query, each head’s dot-product scores are softmax-normalized over all video keys. We then retain the target-frame slice and average the resulting probabilities over heads. This readout differs from both the block-output features used for PCA and the learned aggregation MLP used during training. Target-frame responses are displayed after normalization by each map’s maximum, with color mapping and interpolation used only for visualization. Thus, the color scale indicates relative spatial response within a map, not an absolute probability shared across layers or noise levels.
blocks.zh: 在同一层和台阶上,我们在正常化和旋转位置编码后提取查询和密钥. 对于固定源查询,每个头的点产品分数在所有视频密钥上都是软马克斯正常的. 然后,我们保留目标范围,并平均计算由此造成的概率。 这种读出方式与五氯苯甲醚所使用的阻塞-输出特性和在培训期间使用的已学习到的聚合磁性成像法不同。 目标框架反应在正常化后按每张地图的最大值显示,颜色映射和插图只用于可视化. 因此,颜色尺度表示地图内的相对空间响应,而不是分层共享的绝对概率或噪声水平.

blocks.en: The denoising axis uses the actual model noise timesteps along the sampled inference trajectory. The noise-dependent shift in structure formation motivates our layer-routing schedule, whose generation performance is evaluated against fixed-layer and alternative schedules in Table 6 .

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: GAD improves scene and dynamic consistency across all three video backbones by transferring geometric correspondences during training, while preserving the original inference procedure. Its current design suggests three directions for further improvement.
blocks.zh: GAD通过在训练期间传输几何通信,同时保留原有的推论程序,改善了所有三个视频主干线的场景和动态一致性. 它目前的设计为进一步改进提出了三个方向。

blocks.en: Our results demonstrate that attention distillation with geometric correspondence targets improves video consistency. The current implementation extracts these targets from VGGT- Ω \Omega attention, making their quality dependent on the teacher’s matching ability and spatial resolution. This raises a natural question: can more reliable correspondences further improve the effectiveness of attention distillation? Stronger correspondence estimators or complementary sources of matching evidence could provide more accurate and complete supervision, particularly for ambiguous appearance, occlusion, and moving objects. The correspondence-based formulation of GAD provides a basis for exploring such alternatives to the current geometry teacher.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,用几何对应目标进行注意力分解可以提高视频的一致性。 当前执行从 VGGT 中提取这些目标 - 组合 \ Omega 注意, 使其质量依赖于老师的匹配能力和空间分辨率 。 这提出了一个自然的问题:更可靠的函证能否进一步提高注意力蒸馏的效果? 更强的函证估计器或匹配证据的补充来源可以提供更准确和完整的监督,特别是对模棱两可的外观、隐蔽和移动物体的监督。 基于通信的性别与发展的表述为探索目前几何教师的这种替代方法提供了基础。

blocks.en: Our noise-timestep routing improves geometric metrics over fixed-layer supervision, demonstrating the value of adapting supervision depth to the denoising state. The current layer assignment depends only on the noise timestep and remains fixed throughout training. As the video model learns, the layers that benefit most from correspondence supervision may also change. Conditioning routing jointly on noise timestep and training progress could better match supervision to the model’s evolving representations, extending the current mechanism while preserving the original inference procedure.
blocks.zh: 我们的噪音时步路径比固定层的监管改进了几何测量标准,显示了监管深度适应去诺状态的价值. 目前的层层任务只取决于噪音时间步,在整个训练期间保持不变。 随着视频模型的学习,从函授监督中受益最大的层层也可能发生变化. 在噪音时间步骤和培训进展上共同规定路径,可以更好地使监督与模型不断发展的表述方式相匹配,扩大现行机制,同时保留原来的推论程序。

blocks.en: GAD improves static and dynamic consistency in Wan’s bidirectional video models. Autoregressive video generation offers a natural next setting, where preserving scene identity over long rollouts and maintaining coherent object motion remain important challenges. The principle of guiding attention with correspondences also applies to associations between newly generated content and preceding frames. Adapting the distillation objectives to the available temporal context under causal attention could help autoregressive models retain scene structure and moving-object identity as generation proceeds. This offers a promising route to extending the benefits demonstrated here to autoregressive generation.
blocks.zh: GAD改善Wan双向视频模型的静态和动态一致性. 自动后退的视频生成提供了一个自然的下一个设定,在这种设定中,维护场景身份而不是长期推出,并保持一致的物体运动仍然是重大挑战。 指导注意通信的原则也适用于新生成的内容和前述框架之间的关联。 使蒸馏目标适应因果注意下的现有时间背景,可有助于自旋模型在生成过程中保留场景结构和移动对象身份. 这为将这里所显示的惠益扩展到自动递减的生成提供了一个有希望的途径。
